daily_schedule.details_and_significance: The sacred morning awakening prayers performed to the primary Swayambhu Lingam of Lord Mallikarjuna Swamy. Mangalavadyams begin at 4:30 AM followed by Suprabhatam at 5:00 AM.

daily_schedule.ritual_name: Nija Rupa Darshanam & Garbhagriha Sparsha Abhishekam
daily_schedule.details_and_significance: A globally unique feature where common pilgrims holding valid tickets are permitted to enter the core sanctum to physically touch the Jyotirlingam and perform direct water abhishekam.
Sacred vermilion prayers offered in morning and evening slots at the altar of the Divine Mother, which is historically revered as one of the 18 premier Ashta Dasa Shakti Peethas.
Grand multi-day celebration featuring distinct daily Alankarams and grand vehicle processions (Vahana Sevas) for Goddess Bhramaramba Devi.
Utsavas completed after washing tridents in Mallika Gundam water body. Note: During Maha Shivaratri, general timings are extended.
